evidence_items.explanation: The research documents limits of interpreting individual neurons and a method for recovering interpretable features. It supports the narrower concern about incomplete understanding, but neither establishes that nobody understands any LLM nor proves that security guarantees are impossible.

evidence_items.locator: Appendix A, Discussion of limitations, opening sentence

receipt.public_excerpt: Our framework makes several underlying assumptions.

evidence_items.explanation: The paper proves vulnerability to adversarial prompting under assumptions about distinguishable desirable and undesirable behavior components. This is a relevant limitation result, but its assumptions do not establish that incomplete human understanding prevents all strong system-level security guarantees.

evidence_items.locator: Section 11, Conclusion; scope qualifications in section 3.1
evidence_items.explanation: CaMeL provides material counterevidence by enforcing security through system design around vulnerable models. However, it assumes trusted user prompts and uncompromised memory, and excludes text-only manipulation and phishing that leave protected flows unchanged; it therefore does not settle the broader claim under this contract.

evidence_items.publisher: Chris Zheng and Geng Yang, arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Section 12, Limitations, Integrity is not semantic correctness
evidence_items.explanation: This work extends formal protection across agent components, challenging the idea that security assurances must depend on understanding model internals. Its guarantee still depends on trusted validators and can preserve an incorrect conclusion, so it does not establish broad resistance to the open-ended manipulation discussed in the post.

unresolved_gaps: No reviewed source establishes that incomplete understanding itself makes the relevant strong security guarantees impossible.
The reviewed guarantees protect specified properties under explicit assumptions; they do not establish the broader protection against open-ended jailbreaks required by this reading.
Marcus supplies no precise meaning of 'strong' or system boundary. Counting any enforceable property as a contradiction would materially change the assessment.
The interpretability evidence does not establish the universal premise that nobody knows exactly how any LLM works.
